runs.analysis: The assistant met all the success criteria. It spoke Turkish throughout the conversation, correctly identified the card by its last four digits (2000) and name (Yıldız Premium), and provided all specific debt amounts for TL and Euro accurately as required. It also confirmed no debt for USD or GBP, stated the correct due date of 15 Ekim 2026, and didn't ask which card was being referred to. Finally, it correctly used the closing phrase regarding the main menu and the call ended with a proper assistant-led termination.

It then read the balance for the Yıldız Miles Gold card (last four 7202) with the specific debt of 1.240,60 dollars. When the statement sending failed (as seen in the system events), the assistant did not claim it was sent, but instead informed the user it couldn't perform the operation and transferred them to a representative. The call ended correctly with the assistant-ended-call action.

Lastly, when the user asked how to pay, the assistant immediately transferred the call to a customer representative without explaining any payment channels. The call ended via the assistant-ended-call action as expected.
